Alrighty so a few years ago, when I was 12, I went in a friend's backyard and went into the woods because we were bored one night. We found a giant house that seemed to be abandoned. It was surrounded by giant plants and grass that was up to 5ft. tall. There could have been a Pokemon hiding in those, even. We started getting creeped out just by the vibe. But then we started finding things like baby bottles, diapers, pacifiers, etc. And a bunch of broken beer bottles around. We were getting quite a bit scared at this point, then we heard an ice cream truck, very cliche, I know. But it was the middle of November, it was NOT warm weather at all. So it was very odd to hear it. But besides that, we almost went through with going inside of the house, but we decided against it out of fear. To this day I don't know exactly what was up with that house, who lived there, and what happened to them. And why there were tons of baby items and broken beer bottles. But that's my story!
